newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 598 contract.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 598 contract.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 598 contracts compared with 400 overnight Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 65 wheat, 179 corn, 299 soybean, 34 soymeal, 16 soyoil, three oat and two soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 1-3/4 cents per bushel higher, corn was unchanged to 1/2 cent lower and soybeans were 1-3/4 to 2-1/2 cents per bushel higher.
